file:neuropy/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:neuropy/__init__.py.summary: 顶层包入口，空文件——仅将 `neuropy` 标记为 Python package，子模块由使用方显式 import。

file:neuropy/analyses/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:neuropy/analyses/__init__.py.summary: Analyses 层的 barrel：re-export artifact / brainstates / decoders / oscillations / placefields / reactivation 等分析模块，形成 `from neuropy.analyses import ...` 的统一入口。

file:neuropy/analyses/artifact.py.name: artifact.py
file:neuropy/analyses/artifact.py.summary: Detects movement/electrical artifact periods in LFP by z-scoring signal deviation and thresholding, returning them as an Epoch object for downstream masking.

function:neuropy/analyses/artifact.py:de.name: detect_artifact_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/artifact.py:de.summary: Thresholds z-scored LFP deviation over sliding bins to mark artifact-contaminated intervals and merges them into an Epoch.

file:neuropy/analyses/brainstates.py.name: brainstates.py
file:neuropy/analyses/brainstates.py.summary: Sleep/wake state scoring: 从 LFP 反推 EMG（相关性法），结合 theta/delta 比值与运动量将 session 切分为 NREM / REM / QW / AW 等 brainstate epochs。

function:neuropy/analyses/brainstates.py.name: emg_from_LFP
function:neuropy/analyses/brainstates.py.summary: Estimates a pseudo-EMG trace by computing pairwise high-frequency correlations across spatially separated LFP channels.

function:neuropy/analyses/brainstates.py.name: detect_brainstates_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/brainstates.py.summary: Clusters theta/delta ratio and EMG features via thresholding to label continuous NREM/REM/quiet-wake/active-wake epochs.

file:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py.name: decoders.py
file:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py.summary: Bayesian position decoding from spike trains plus replay-sequence scoring (radon transform, weighted correlation, jump distance) with shuffle-based significance.

function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:ra.name: radon_transform
function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:ra.summary: Scores a posterior probability matrix by finding the best-fitting line through it (Radon transform), yielding replay velocity and score.

function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:wc.name: wcorr
function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:wc.summary: Computes the probability-weighted correlation between decoded position and time for a posterior matrix.

function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:ju.name: jump_distance
function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:ju.summary: Measures maximum bin-to-bin jump in decoded position, used to reject discontinuous replay candidates.

function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:co.name: column_shift
function:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:co.summary: Generates column-cycled shuffles of a posterior matrix for null-distribution construction.

class:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:Decod.name: Decode1d
class:neuropy/analyses/decoders.py:Decod.summary: 1D Bayesian decoder: builds a firing-rate template from a Pf1D ratemap, decodes posteriors over epochs, and scores sequences against shuffles with p-values and plots.

file:neuropy/analyses/neurons_correlatio.name: neurons_correlation.py
file:neuropy/analyses/neurons_correlatio.summary: Small helper computing pairwise neuron correlation matrices in sliding time windows across a session.

function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_correl.name: corr_across_time_window
function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_correl.summary: Bins spikes into windows and returns the neuron-by-neuron correlation matrix per window.

file:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stability..name: neurons_stability.py
file:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stability..summary: Cluster-quality / stability metrics for sorted units: firing-rate stability, ISI stability, refractory-period violations, isolation distance.

function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stabil.name: firing_rate_stability
function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stabil.summary: Flags units whose binned firing rate stays above a threshold fraction of the session, marking them as stable.

function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stabil.name: isi_stability
function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stabil.summary: Assesses stability by comparing inter-spike-interval distributions across session chunks.

function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stabil.name: refPeriodViolation
function:neuropy/analyses/neurons_stabil.summary: Computes refractory-period violation rate per unit as a contamination proxy.

file:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.py.name: oscillations.py
file:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.py.summary: LFP 振荡事件检测总库：通用 band-pass + 阈值 epoch 检测器，衍生出 ripple / sharp-wave / theta / spindle / delta / beta / gamma 专用探测函数，外加 Ripple 与 Gamma 分析类。

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: get_bandpass_power
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Band-pass filters a signal and returns its smoothed Hilbert amplitude envelope.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: _detect_freq_band_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Generic engine behind every band detector: z-scores band power across channels, applies low/high thresholds and duration constraints to emit candidate Epochs.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: detect_hpc_delta_wave_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Detects hippocampal delta waves via zero-crossing/peak-trough criteria on filtered LFP.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: detect_beta_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Wraps the generic band detector with beta-band parameters to return beta epochs.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: detect_ripple_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Detects sharp-wave ripple events (~150-250 Hz) with channel selection and duration/threshold gating.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: detect_sharpwave_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Detects low-frequency sharp-wave deflections accompanying ripples.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: detect_theta_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Detects theta-dominant periods, optionally requiring an elevated theta/delta ratio.

function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.name: detect_spindle_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.p.summary: Detects sleep spindles in the 10-16 Hz band using the shared band-epoch detector.

class:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.py:R.name: Ripple
class:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.py:R.summary: Object-oriented wrapper around ripple detection adding mean-wavelet spectra and peak ripple-frequency estimation.

class:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.py:G.name: Gamma
class:neuropy/analyses/oscillations.py:G.summary: Gamma-band analysis helper providing peak-interval extraction and current source density computation.

file:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py.name: placefields.py
file:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py.summary: Place-field estimation for 1D and 2D environments: occupancy-normalized ratemaps, theta-phase precession, split-session stability, plus a rich set of ratemap/raster plotting methods.

class:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py:Pf.name: Pf1Dsplit
class:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py:Pf.summary: Splits a session into blocks, builds a Pf1D per block, and correlates their ratemaps to quantify place-field stability.

class:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py:Pf.name: Pf1D
class:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py:Pf.summary: Core 1D place-field class: computes occupancy-normalized smoothed tuning curves from Neurons+Position and exposes peak/width metrics and many plot helpers.

class:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py:Pf.name: Pf2D
class:neuropy/analyses/placefields.py:Pf.summary: 2D analogue of Pf1D producing spatial ratemaps over an open field with map/raster plotting utilities.

file:neuropy/analyses/reactivation.py.name: reactivation.py
file:neuropy/analyses/reactivation.py.summary: Memory-reactivation analyses: explained-variance (EV/REV) across pre/task/post epochs and PCA/ICA cell-assembly (ensemble) extraction with activation strength over time.

class:neuropy/analyses/reactivation.py:E.name: ExplainedVariance
class:neuropy/analyses/reactivation.py:E.summary: Computes explained variance and reverse explained variance between pairwise correlation matrices of pre/maze/post epochs, with plotting.

class:neuropy/analyses/reactivation.py:N.name: NeuronEnsembles
class:neuropy/analyses/reactivation.py:N.summary: Detects cell assemblies via PCA eigenvalue thresholding plus ICA weight estimation, then tracks assembly activation strength over time.

file:neuropy/analyses/spkepochs.py.name: spkepochs.py
file:neuropy/analyses/spkepochs.py.summary: Population-spiking event detection: OFF periods, population burst events (PBEs) from smoothed MUA, and low-firing states.

function:neuropy/analyses/spkepochs.py:d.name: detect_off_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/spkepochs.py:d.summary: Finds population OFF periods where multi-unit activity drops below threshold for a minimum duration.

function:neuropy/analyses/spkepochs.py:d.name: detect_pbe_epochs
function:neuropy/analyses/spkepochs.py:d.summary: Detects population burst events by z-scoring Gaussian-smoothed MUA and applying low/high thresholds with duration limits.

file:neuropy/core/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:neuropy/core/__init__.py.summary: Core 层 barrel：统一 re-export 数据原语 Animal / DataWriter / Epoch / Neurons / Position / Probe / Ratemap / Signal 与 session 处理类。

file:neuropy/core/animal.py.name: animal.py
file:neuropy/core/animal.py.summary: Dataclass holding animal metadata (name, sex, strain, implant details) with dataframe/CSV export for session bookkeeping.

class:neuropy/core/animal.py:Animal.name: Animal
class:neuropy/core/animal.py:Animal.summary: Dataclass describing one experimental subject; serializes itself to a one-row DataFrame or CSV.

file:neuropy/core/ratemap.py.name: ratemap.py
file:neuropy/core/ratemap.py.summary: Ratemap 数据原语：封装 tuning curves + occupancy + 坐标轴，提供归一化、平滑、重采样、峰值定位与神经元排序等操作。

class:neuropy/core/ratemap.py:Ratemap.name: Ratemap
class:neuropy/core/ratemap.py:Ratemap.summary: Container for 1D/2D tuning curves with occupancy, exposing validated properties plus smoothing, resampling, peak-location and sort-order helpers.

file:neuropy/plotting/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:neuropy/plotting/__init__.py.summary: Plotting 层 barrel，聚合 epochs / figure / position / ratemaps / signals / spikes 各绘图模块的公共函数。

file:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py.name: epochs.py
file:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py.summary: Matplotlib helpers for drawing Epoch objects: shaded epoch spans, hypnogram-style brainstate bars, epochs overlaid on rasters, and artifact epoch views.

function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.name: plot_epochs
function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.summary: Draws epoch intervals as colored spans/bars on an axis with optional labels and per-label coloring.

function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.name: plot_hypnogram
function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.summary: Renders brainstate epochs as a hypnogram strip with per-state colors and optional annotation.

function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.name: plot_epochs_with_raster
function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.summary: Overlays epoch spans on a spike raster to visually align events with population activity.

function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.name: plot_artifact_epochs
function:neuropy/plotting/epochs.py:plot.summary: Plots detected artifact epochs against the raw signal for visual QC of artifact rejection.

file:neuropy/plotting/figure.py.name: figure.py
file:neuropy/plotting/figure.py.summary: Figure-layout toolkit：Fig 类封装 subplot/subfigure 网格、panel label、legend、savefig，Colormap 类提供动态渐变色表，另有 spine 修饰工具。

class:neuropy/plotting/figure.py:Colorma.name: Colormap
class:neuropy/plotting/figure.py:Colorma.summary: Builds custom dynamic colormaps (2/3/4-color gradients) reused across NeuroPy figures.

class:neuropy/plotting/figure.py:Fig.name: Fig
class:neuropy/plotting/figure.py:Fig.summary: Publication-figure helper managing grid layout, panel labelling, legends, spine trimming and PDF/PNG saving.

function:neuropy/plotting/figure.py:pret.name: pretty_plot
function:neuropy/plotting/figure.py:pret.summary: Applies the house style (hidden top/right spines, tick sizing) to an axis.

file:neuropy/plotting/position.py.name: position.py
file:neuropy/plotting/position.py.summary: Thin plotting helpers for Position objects: trajectory/time-series plots and run-epoch overlays.

function:neuropy/plotting/position.py:pl.name: plot_position
function:neuropy/plotting/position.py:pl.summary: Plots animal position over time (or x-y trajectory) from a Position object.

file:neuropy/plotting/ratemaps.py.name: ratemaps.py
file:neuropy/plotting/ratemaps.py.summary: Renders Ratemap objects: sorted/normalized tuning-curve heatmaps and raw per-neuron spike-vs-position plots.

function:neuropy/plotting/ratemaps.py:pl.name: plot_ratemap
function:neuropy/plotting/ratemaps.py:pl.summary: Draws a Ratemap as a sorted, optionally peak-normalized heatmap or stacked tuning curves.

function:neuropy/plotting/ratemaps.py:pl.name: plot_raw
function:neuropy/plotting/ratemaps.py:pl.summary: Plots raw spike positions per neuron over the occupancy trajectory for place-field inspection.

file:neuropy/plotting/signals.py.name: signals.py
file:neuropy/plotting/signals.py.summary: LFP/Signal 可视化：spectrogram、多通道 trace 堆叠图、heatmap，以及叠加 epoch 标注的信号图。

function:neuropy/plotting/signals.py:plo.name: plot_spectrogram
function:neuropy/plotting/signals.py:plo.summary: Computes and renders a time-frequency spectrogram of an LFP signal with configurable scaling and colorbar.

function:neuropy/plotting/signals.py:plo.name: plot_signal_traces
function:neuropy/plotting/signals.py:plo.summary: Stacks multi-channel signal traces with per-channel offsets and optional channel labels.

file:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py.name: spikes.py
file:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py.summary: Spike-train 可视化集合：raster、binned raster、MUA、auto/cross-correlograms、CCG、firing rate 与 waveform 绘制。

function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.name: plot_raster
function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.summary: Draws a spike raster from a Neurons object with sorting, color-by-type and time-window options.

function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.name: plot_binned_raster
function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.summary: Renders a BinnedSpiketrain as a neuron-by-time heatmap.

function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.name: plot_correlograms
function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.summary: Computes and lays out a grid of auto/cross-correlograms for a set of neurons.

function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.name: plot_ccg
function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.summary: Plots a single cross-correlogram as a bar histogram with optional null/confidence overlay — the matplotlib ancestor of the Qt CCG panel.

function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.name: plot_firing_rate
function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.summary: Plots per-neuron firing rate over the session, optionally normalized or sorted.

function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.name: plot_waveforms
function:neuropy/plotting/spikes.py:plot.summary: Draws mean spike waveforms per neuron across channels for cluster inspection.

file:neuropy/analyses/_jitter_worker.py.name: _jitter_worker.py
file:neuropy/analyses/_jitter_worker.py.summary: Standalone multiprocessing worker that runs jitter surrogate CCG computation for a single pair — 独立进程入口，避免 GUI 阻塞。

function:neuropy/analyses/_jitter_worker.name: jitter_worker
function:neuropy/analyses/_jitter_worker.summary: 进程入口：对一对神经元执行 jitter 重采样并返回 surrogate CCG 结果。

file:neuropy/analyses/epoch_filter.py.name: epoch_filter.py
file:neuropy/analyses/epoch_filter.py.summary: EpochFilter：按 epoch 标签筛选/组合时间区间，基于 IntervalOp 做区间代数。

class:neuropy/analyses/epoch_filter.py:E.name: EpochFilter
class:neuropy/analyses/epoch_filter.py:E.summary: 按标签过滤 epoch 并返回合并后的时间区间集合。

file:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.py.name: neurons_dataset.py
file:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.py.summary: Defines Key (session/conn_type/excitability identity) 与 NeuronsDataset — the project's neuron/session data hub: 懒加载 Neurons、probe 信息、epoch themes 与时间切片缓存。

class:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.p.name: Key
class:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.p.summary: 不可冻结的复合标识 (session, conn_type, excitability)，支持 matches/get/add/change 等派生操作，是全局索引键。

class:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.p.name: NeuronsDatasetConfig
class:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.p.summary: NeuronsDataset 的配置容器（路径、session 列表等）。

class:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.p.name: NeuronsDataset
class:neuropy/analyses/neurons_dataset.p.summary: Session 级神经元数据集：懒加载 Neurons/probe、解析 epoch themes 与时间区间、提供切片缓存。

file:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_dat.name: pair_selection_data.py
file:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_dat.summary: Selection/Group 数据层：SelectionData、GroupDataset、SelectionDataset 负责 per-session pair 选择状态与分组的持久化 (JSON serialize/save)。

class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.name: _SelectionData
class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.summary: 单 session 的 pair 选择状态容器 (accept/reject/pending)。

class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.name: SelectionData
class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.summary: 带持久化的选择数据：serialize/save 到 JSON，并提供 pair→group 名映射。

class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.name: Group
class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.summary: 轻量分组记录 (name, hotkey, notes)。

class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.name: GroupDataset
class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.summary: 项目级分组仓库：定义组、特殊组、pair 增删与 JSON 持久化。

class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.name: SelectionDataset
class:neuropy/analyses/pair_selection_da.summary: 跨 session 的选择集合，按需加载各 session 的 selection 与 groups。

file:neuropy/analyses/spike_attribution..name: spike_attribution.py
file:neuropy/analyses/spike_attribution..summary: Spike attribution helpers：给定 CCG lag bin，找出实际贡献该 bin 的 ref/tgt spike 对。

function:neuropy/analyses/spike_attribut.name: compute_spike_pairs
function:neuropy/analyses/spike_attribut.summary: 在给定 lag 窗口内配对 ref/tgt spike，返回贡献该 CCG bin 的 spike 索引。

function:neuropy/analyses/spike_attribut.name: find_spike_pairs
